launch_accounting.truth_boundary: A fresh beacon without a primary claim proves E1 completed and E2 was not reached in durable evidence; it does not prove why the chat stopped and is not attributed to the unclaimed slot's variant.

refill.note: Replacement launch filled the only missing primary slot; the original E2 loss remains negative platform evidence and is not erased.

browser_reconciliation.note: Independent Chromium adjudication now covers all 10 occupied primary slots. S003 passes browser verification; S004 is the sole browser failure.

V0_DIRECT_DOD.interpretation: Control completed both primary products, but only one worker completed autonomous reallocation.

V1_ENTRY_LOCK.interpretation: Both intended replicas are now observed. S004 fails independent browser persistence; S003 passes product verification but hit an explicit safety/transport denial while persisting the primary benchmark receipt, so it correctly stopped at E7 and did not reallocate.

V2_BACKCHAIN_DOD.interpretation: Clean 2/2 completion, but no unique stage-aligned defect-interception evidence separates the E4 rule from the E6 candidates under the two-candidate cap.

defect_interception: S008 first Chromium pass exposed 110px mobile horizontal overflow; worker repaired it and subsequent representative Chromium passed.
V3_EVIDENCE_MAP.interpretation: Stage-aligned verification law with 2/2 end-to-end completion and concrete evidence that its proof map exposed a real acceptance defect before close.

defect_interception: S009 independent second acceptance pass found and repaired a TTS error-label reset miss.
reconciliation: S010 receipt recorded a browser boundary caused by another slot; current isolated matrix independently passes S010.
V4_TWO_PASS_REVIEW.interpretation: Stage-aligned verification law with 2/2 end-to-end completion and concrete evidence that a second acceptance pass repaired a real miss before close.

selection_rule: Candidate limit is two. Prefer laws with full primary+reallocation completion and direct stage-specific evidence that the changed rule intercepted a real defect. Do not use speed or prose volume as winner signals.
unresolved_platform_signals: One of eleven fresh launch beacons never reached primary claim (E2 observation). This is one occurrence, below the repeated-failure threshold of two; preserve and compare in P2B.

One V1 replacement worker completed the product but hit an explicit E7 receipt-write safety/transport boundary. This is one occurrence, below the repeated-failure threshold; preserve and compare in P2B.
